text:
maya_cs: FYI forwarded a Zendesk ticket from ZenithCare SRE — they want APAC egress peering + temporary rate bump for onboarding weekend. Ticket #ZC-4207. They expect big spikes Sat-Sun.
liam_support: what account id and CIDRs do we have? any certs/peering already in place?
maya_cs: acct: zenithcare-prod-011. Customer provided NAT IPs: 203.0.113.45/32 and 203.0.113.46/32. Request: exempt those IPs from egress throttling and bump rate from 60 rps -> 250 rps for 48h starting 2026-04-11T00:00Z. Quote from SRE: "pilot cohort ~10k users, bursty but short-lived"
harper_netops: OK. plan: add IPs to customer-egress-allowlist, attach route via apac-peering-prod, set temporary rate_policy (250 rps, 48h), create rollback at +50h. Need eng-oncall signoff to touch routing ACLs and peering entries.
eng-oncall: approve to proceed. change id RC-2026-115. please notify oncall channel when you flip the ACLs. :thumbsup:
maya_cs: Thanks. I'll confirm with the customer now. @harper_netops can you paste the exact curl we should run so support can trigger it when we have the greenlight?
harper_netops: Sure — admin API commands below; run from internal ops bastion only.
harper_netops: ```
curl -X POST "https://console.internal.redwood/api/v1/customers/zenithcare-prod-011/egress-allowlist" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"ips":["203.0.113.45/32","203.0.113.46/32"], "note":"APAC onboarding sprint 2026-04-11"}'

curl -X POST "https://console.internal.redwood/api/v1/customers/zenithcare-prod-011/rate-config" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"rate_rps":250, "duration":"48h", "change_id":"RC-2026-115"}'
```
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: rollout id RC-2026-115 at 2026-04-11T00:05:00Z. Status: pending
harper_netops: Done — RC-2026-115 applied at 2026-04-11T00:06:12Z. Short log:
```
[2026-04-11T00:06:12Z] apply change RC-2026-115: add 203.0.113.45/32,203.0.113.46/32 to customer-egress-allowlist
[2026-04-11T00:06:13Z] attach route apac-peering-prod -> zenithcare-prod-011
[2026-04-11T00:06:15Z] set rate_policy 250 rps, ttl 48h, rollback scheduled +50h
```
maya_cs: Awesome — two asks after this:
  1) add note to renewal_notes: "Onboarded pilot with temporary quota bump; positive signal for upsell; monitor usage for next 30d"
  2) schedule enablement walkthrough for their SREs next Wed so they understand peering + failover behavior
liam_support: I'll own the follow-up. I'll send a calendar invite for Wed and capture CSAT + feedback in Zendesk. Will also confirm when we remove the temp bump.
eng-oncall: added monitoring: token-level traces turned on for zenithcare-prod-011, alert if p95 latency > 450ms or error rate > 1%. Tags: zenithcare-prod-011, RC-2026-115
maya_cs: Great work team — I'll update the Zendesk ticket and ping the customer with the schedule. Closing loop here. :white_check_mark:
